text:
Jules (People Ops): quick help please  traveler in Tokyo paid a taxi in cash but lost the paper receipt. They need reimbursement. What alternative proofs do we accept for Japan, and any VAT reclaim nuance?

Hiro N: we can reimburse cash taxis if they provide reasonable proof. Common alternatives: photo of taxi meter showing amount + license plate, Google Maps route screenshot with time, bank transfer receipt if they reimbursed driver later, and a short attestation.

Jules (People Ops): they have a photo of the meter and a timestamped map screenshot, plus the driver's plate number. No paper receipt. Is an attestation from the traveler enough for Finance?

Finance Bot: Guideline (auto):
```
- Primary: original merchant receipt (paper or digital)
- If missing: at least two corroborating items from: meter photo with amount & time, GPS route screenshot (map with start/end + timestamp), app-based trip record (if any), or witness attestation (colleague or vendor)
- Attach a short attestation: "I confirm this taxi was taken for business travel on [date] from [A] to [B]; original receipt lost."
- Proof of payment: if cash, a photo showing exchange of cash is helpful but not required.
```

Finance Bot: For Japan VAT: taxis are not VAT-recoverable in most cases, so VAT reclaim is not applicable; treat as non-recoverable service expense. No special VAT invoice needed.

Emma T: also confirm we need the trip purpose and cost center. In the expense form choose category "Ground Transportation" and in the description put meeting/trip code + person met, e.g., "Tokyo conf - transfer to hotel".

Hiro N: small policy nuance  if multiple cash taxis on same trip (e.g., train delay -> cab) put them on one expense with multiple line items and attach map/photos for each.

Jules (People Ops): good to know. Anything about currency conversion if traveler paid in JPY and we reimburse in USD?

Finance Bot: Use the card/bank rate on date of expense if using a company card. For cash: use XE or OANDA rate on the date of travel and attach a screenshot. In the expense form include: original JPY amount, converted USD amount, exchange rate source.

Legal R: quick reminder: if the trip included a client entertainment portion, get client attendee and purpose in the notes for compliance. For internal transfers just note "hotel transfer".

Jules (People Ops): one more  traveler asked if we can accept a taxi app screenshot from a local app (e.g., JapanTaxi). They didn't use it but asked hypothetically. Do we accept app screenshots as primary receipts?

Finance Bot: Yes: if the app generates a trip invoice or transaction record with merchant name, amount, date/time, and a transaction id, we accept it as primary receipt. Prefer PDFs or screenshots that show the full invoice.

Emma T: final step  i'll message the traveler with a checklist: meter photo, map screenshot, short attestation, expense category, JPY + USD conversion screenshot. Suggest they submit within 7 days.

Jules (People Ops): perfect 64f I'll send that now. Thanks all!
